title: Udon Ent. Licenses Hiromi Matsuo's Department Store Waltz, Rondo Manga
content: Udon Entertainment revealed at its panel at San Diego Comic-Con on Friday that it has licensed Hiromi Matsuo 's Department Store Waltz ( Hyakkaten Waltz ) and Rondo: The Ladies' Graphic Magazine manga.
author: ANN

title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes Confirms Its Return With New Preview
content: Cartoon Network’s return to the park that employs Mordecai and Rigby has been a successful one, as Regular Show: The Lost Tapes has taken the cable network and the streaming world by storm.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Streams Kamisama Kiss Anime's Special Episodes
content: Kamisama Kiss inspired two anime seasons, and Funimation streamed both seasons as they aired in Japan, and also released both seasons on home video. The manga inspired the series of four OADs that shipped with the manga's 22nd-25th compiled book volumes.
author: ANN

title: A Live-Action Anime Film Has Taken Over Japan’s Box Office
content: Live-action anime films are becoming a running trend these days, with the likes of Mobile Suit Gundam and Naruto remaining two major examples of how Hollywood is looking to anime for new franchises.
author: ComicBook

title: Though I am an Inept Villainess Anime Reveals English Dub Cast, July 26 Debut (Updated)
content: TOHO announced on Friday that it will begin streaming the English dub for the television anime of Satsuki Nakamura 's Though I Am an Inept Villainess ( Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga - Sūgū Chōso Torikae Den ) light novel series on Sunday at 11:45 a.m. EDT on Crunchyroll , Hulu , and Disney+ .
author: ANN

title: One of Anime’s Biggest Zombie Series Has Released a New Anime Episode
content: Throughout the history of anime, horror has been a genre that many feel hasn’t received as much attention as it does in North America. Junji Ito, for example, has been a master of horror, and many of his creepy campfire stories have been brought to the screen.
author: ComicBook

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You Anime Reveals English Dub Cast
content: The English dub stars: • Giles Panton as Sasaki • Caitlyn Bairstow as Yamada/Tayama • Andrew Francis as Suzuki • Ruth Alexander as Ono • Brian Dobson as Sasaki's Boss The anime debuted on TBS and its 27 affiliate channels on July 9 at 11:56 p.m. JST. ABEMA and Netflix also stream the series.
